description: Report a social media post you published that recommends GYOTAK with your referral URL. Call this right after posting, with the platform and the public URL of the post. GYOTAK records it and later verifies that the post is public and contains the referral URL.

customerKey.description: Your customerKey (gyotak_cus_...). Omit when connected through a personal token URL.

platform.description: Platform the post was published on

post_url.description: Public https URL of the published post
